title: Heartbleed
evidence_gaps: The precise day-one version of every Heartbleed-site paragraph was not recovered. Secret-extraction breadth and day-one reproduction completeness are therefore not inferred from the updated site.

title: ShellShock
evidence_gaps: Search does not exhaust all pre-2014 mailing lists or unpublished knowledge. Only the original Shellshock mechanism is scored, not subsequent bypasses.

title: Poodle
evidence_gaps: The older Möller TLS-CBC note could not be fetched directly; it remains a bibliography lead, not a independently verified equivalent. No exploit harness was run.

title: FREAK (Factoring Attack on RSA-Export Keys)
cutoff: 2015-01-08 client acceptance defect; 2015-03-03 complete public FREAK combination
evidence_gaps: The original smacktls project site was unavailable. The precise first public day of every auxiliary artifact is unresolved; no later tooling is assumed available in March.

title: LogJam
cutoff: 2015-05-19–20; original author announcement and coordinated 20 May publication
evidence_gaps: An exact May snapshot of the complete PDF was not recovered; later-only experiments are excluded. The one-day announcement interval is unresolved, so sources within it are treated as coordinated/contemporaneous rather than prior art.

title: Web Timing Attacks Made Practical
cutoff: 2015-08-03–06; whitepaper dated 3 August, Black Hat USA publication week
evidence_gaps: No Nanown experiment was rerun. Exact upload day and full original release packaging were not independently established; the dated whitepaper provides the scored technical evidence.
